free_tier.stated: No free tier. NVPS Micro is EUR 7.99 excluding VAT for one year, which the page prints as 'EUR 0,67 Monthly = EUR 7,99 EUR for one year'. A 7-day free trial is offered on NVPS Micro, NVPS 1, NVPS 2 and NVPS 4.

retention.stated: billed annually on the entry plan; the page states of the trial 'When the 7 days end, the service is suspended unless the invoice is paid; pay it and it stays active'. No deletion interval after non-payment was published on any page read.

egress.terms: 500 GB monthly traffic on NVPS Micro, in the vendor's decimal unit

interface_detail: full root over SSH plus a console in the browser; unprivileged LXC on Proxmox VE, 11 Linux images
tooling: any SSH client; no API documented on the pages read
chaining: the largest shape under USD 1.50 a month found at 1 GB of RAM, with a real public IPv6 address that answers on any port and 20 forwarded IPv4 ports for the services that must be reachable from IPv4

limits.value: 500 GB of monthly traffic on the entry plan
20 consecutive ports on the node's shared public IPv4, each forwarded to the same port number inside the guest, allocated by hand through a ticket

binding_note: ports 80 and 443 cannot be obtained at all, because the vendor states those 'cannot be given to a single customer', so an IPv4-reachable web service is impossible and the 20-port window is the whole inbound budget.

identity_cost.detail: a WHMCS account; the registration form requires first name, last name and email only, with phone, address, city and postcode present but not marked required. Payment is a card through the WHMCS checkout, so a card is required even though the 7-day trial charges nothing. The accepted card types and any authorisation hold were not published on the pages read. Prices exclude VAT; Romanian VAT is 21 percent and other EU buyers pay their own rate, computed in the cart.

reliability_note: no reliability event observed; no uptime figure and no SLA published on the pages read
confidence_note: price ladder, shape, traffic allowance, port rule, IPv6 delivery and trial terms are quoted from the vendor's own NAT page read; the VAT treatment is quoted from the same page; the legal entity and its Romanian registration number are quoted from the vendor's own footer and about page. The cart could not be priced: every cart.php and /store/nat-vps/<slug> route resolved to the cPanel group, and a deliberately invalid pid resolved to the same place, so the redirect is a property of the route and not evidence about this product. Stock is therefore unknown.

notes: The best shape-per-euro in the band: EUR 7.99 a year for 1 GB of RAM (512 MB RAM plus 512 MB swap), 10 GB SSD and 500 GB a month, which is EUR 0.67 a month or about USD 0.72 at the rate used elsewhere in this corpus. Two things make it a caveat rather than a clean qualify. First, stock is unknown: the cart route could not price any product, and the control with an invalid pid behaved identically, so nothing about availability was established either way. Second, the plan is annual-only, so the money out of pocket is EUR 7.99 plus VAT, not EUR 0.67. The 20 IPv4 ports are allocated by hand through a ticket and 80/443 are explicitly refused, which is a harder limit than sellers that hand out a port range automatically. The public IPv6 is the strong half: any port, no request, which makes it a usable WireGuard endpoint and a usable web origin for IPv6 clients. What is not established: whether the 20 forwarded ports carry UDP, because no page read states a protocol for them; the accepted card types and any authorisation hold; whether stock exists on any plan; and whether the entity is actually trading beyond its own claim, since the Romanian trade register was not queried. Not verified: the 'trading' question for CROCKY S.R.L. A check of the Romanian ONRC register for J2024020698007 would settle it.

extras.term: annual only on the entry plan
extras.price_arithmetic: EUR 7.99 a year excluding VAT / 12 = EUR 0.6658 a month, printed by the vendor as EUR 0.67. Converted at the ECB reference rate read on 2026-10-23 from api.frankfurter.app, EUR 0.89342 per USD, that is USD 0.7453 a month; the money out of pocket is EUR 7.99 = USD 8.94 once a year plus the buyer's VAT. VPS billing: the machine bills whether it runs or not, so the 10 h/day and 24/7 figures are identical.
extras.renewal_usd: EUR 7.99 a year at the same rate; the page states the price is not promotional and the ladder shows no separate renewal column

network_out.ports: 20 consecutive forwarded ports on the shared public IPv4, allocated by ticket, with 80 and 443 explicitly unavailable; the public IPv6 answers on any port

extras.udp: not stated: no page read states whether the 20 forwarded IPv4 ports carry UDP. The IPv6 address is unrestricted and would carry UDP.
